name: But I'm Not Sorry
source: A former soldier tries to rebuild his life 20 years after the kidnapping of his wife and daughter. However, something happened during his time in the army, something that left deep “scars?” on his mind, the truth of which he is only now beginning to uncover. As those “scars” begin to surface, they bring not only danger and complications… but also dark, forbidden desires he never knew he had. How dark and twisted can a once kind man become when years of suffering and buried “scars” start consuming his mind?
